title: Закон за счетоводството (Accounting Act), as passed, including the non-financial declaration (чл. 48 to 52)
citation: Закон за счетоводството, обн. ДВ бр. 95/2015 (приет от 43-то Народно събрание на 24.11.2015, Указ № 237)
evidence: § 29 of the transitional and final provisions: "Законът влиза в сила от 1 януари 2016 г., с изключение на чл. 48 – 52, които влизат в сила от 1 януари 2017 г." Opened https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/act/15501 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the act as passed (decree, title, all chapters, transitional and final provisions). The non-financial declaration, чл. 48 to 52, applies from 2017-01-01; the rest of the act from 2016-01-01, which is the date used. Transposes Directive 2014/95/EU. The act has been amended many times; the amending acts in scope are bg-zschet-zid-2024 (stored) and bg-zschet-zid-2025 (link only). The register row for ДВ бр. 115/2025 and ДВ бр. 27/2026 (phase-in dates) was not matched to a published act on parliament.bg: no act with those numbers and a title naming the Accounting Act was served, so they are not in scope. The publisher serves the act as passed only; parliament.bg has no point-in-time consolidation, and the consolidated text on lex.bg, ciela.net and apis.bg is a private service and is not used. No government English translation was found: looked for on https://www.parliament.bg/en/laws/ID/15501 (the English interface shows the same Bulgarian text; the act API serves language id 1 only) and by web search for an official English text of the act on 2026-11-02. Language stored: bg.

title: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за счетоводството (Act amending the Accounting Act; CSRD transposition, sustainability reporting), as passed
citation: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за счетоводството, ДВ бр. 72/2024 (приет от 50-ото Народно събрание на 14.08.2024, Указ № 221)
evidence: § 42: "Законът влиза в сила от 6 юли 2024 г. с изключение на § 35, който влиза в сила от деня на обнародването на закона в „Държавен вестник“." Opened https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/act/165592 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the amending act as passed. It adds the sustainability reporting rules and the transitional phase-in in § 30; the additional provisions it creates list Directive (EU) 2022/2464 as transposed. In force 2024-07-06 with § 35 from the day of promulgation. The brief gave the gazette day as 2024-08-27 from secondary sources; parliament.bg states only the issue 72 of 2024, so that day is not used. Companion act: bg-znfo-zid-2024 (assurance), link only. The publisher serves the act as passed only; parliament.bg has no point-in-time consolidation, and the consolidated text on lex.bg, ciela.net and apis.bg is a private service and is not used. No government English translation was found: looked for on https://www.parliament.bg/en/laws/ID/165592 (the English interface shows the same Bulgarian text; the act API serves language id 1 only) and by web search for an official English text of the act on 2026-11-02. Language stored: bg.

title: Закон за изменение на Закона за счетоводството (Act amending the Accounting Act; moves the phase-in years of § 30 by one year), as passed
citation: Закон за изменение на Закона за счетоводството, ДВ бр. 17/2025 (приет от 51-вото Народно събрание на 19.02.2025, Указ № 26)
evidence: § 2: "Законът влиза в сила от деня на обнародването му в „Държавен вестник“." The page gives the issue (ДВ бр. 17/2025) but not the gazette day. Opened https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/act/165958 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Changes the years in § 30(1) of the 2024 amending act (2024 to 2025, 2025 to 2026, 2026 to 2027). The gazette day is not stated on parliament.bg (the page gives the issue number and year); dv.parliament.bg did not answer from the cloud address. The in-force day is therefore not read from an official page and the instrument is link only; the text would be stored once the gazette day is read from the gazette. Constitution art. 88(2) (three days after promulgation, unless the law says otherwise) would give a day only after the gazette day is known. No government English translation was found: looked for on https://www.parliament.bg/en/laws/ID/165958 (the English interface shows the same Bulgarian text; the act API serves language id 1 only) and by web search for an official English text of the act on 2026-11-02. Language stored: bg.
status_note: Row passes and the text was fetched, but no official page opened states the gazette day, so no dated record is stored.

title: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за независимия финансов одит (Act amending the Independent Financial Audit Act; sustainability assurance, CSRD), as passed
citation: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за независимия финансов одит, ДВ бр. 79/2024 (приет от 50-ото Народно събрание на 04.09.2024, Указ № 229)
evidence: The act has no commencement clause in the text opened (the last paragraphs, § 94 to § 101, refer to "влизането в сила на закона" without a date). The parliament.bg page gives ДВ бр. 79/2024 but not the gazette day. Opened https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/act/165596 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Adds sustainability assurance engagements to the audit act (the act's title becomes "Закон за независимия финансов одит и изразяването на сигурност по устойчивостта"); its additional provisions list Directive (EU) 2022/2464 as transposed. title: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за защита на потребителите (Act amending the Consumer Protection Act; transposes Directive (EU) 2024/825, environmental claims and sustainability labels), as passed
citation: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за защита на потребителите, ДВ бр. 87/2026 (приет от 52-рото Народно събрание на 10.09.2026, Указ № 305)
evidence: § 83: "Законът влиза в сила от деня на обнародването му в „Държавен вестник“ с изключение на § 1 и 2, § 4, т. 1 относно т. 7 и т. 2 – 4, § 6, § 16 – 19, § 44, т. 1, § 73, т. 3 относно буква „а“ и буква „б“, т. 56 – 66 и т. 4 относно т. 15, които влизат в сила от 27 септември 2026 г." Opened https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/act/167077 on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the amending act as passed. It lists Directive (EU) 2024/825 among the directives it transposes and adds the unfair-practice items on generic environmental claims and sustainability labels ("Общо твърдение за екологосъобразност", "маркировка за устойчивост") to the Consumer Protection Act. The date used is 2026-09-27, the day the provisions on environmental claims start; the other provisions start on the day of promulgation, which parliament.bg does not state, so the act's own first in-force day may be earlier. Not in scope: the base Закон за защита на потребителите (ДВ бр. 99/2005, чл. 68в to 68м), because the base act (ДВ бр. 99/2005) was not found by title among the act ids scanned on parliament.bg (11000 to 20000 and 165500 to 167600) and no official consolidated text could be opened (dv.parliament.bg refused the cloud address); consolidated versions on lex.bg, ciela.net and apis.bg are private services and are not used. Two other 2026 amending acts of the same law (ДВ бр. 13/2026 and бр. 58/2026) concern other subjects and are not in scope. No government English translation was found: looked for on https://www.parliament.bg/en/laws/ID/167077 (the English interface shows the same Bulgarian text; the act API serves language id 1 only) and by web search for an official English text of the act on 2026-11-02. Language stored: bg.
